sources.caption:
Registration for Al-Islah Quran & Solat Academy (AQSA) 2027 is opening soon!

Give your child a strong foundation in Quran and Solat from young. 🌱Whether you’re looking for after-school classes, weeknight or weekend lessons or the convenience of learning online, there are various options to suit your child’s schedule.

📌 Registration opens on 5 October 2026, 9am
